say:1:1430203201:1.text: One look at you and I know you don't drink. That swill is nothing but juice.
say:1:1430203201:1.source_cn: 一看你就很少喝酒，那种水果甜水也能叫不错？
say:1:1430203201:1.male: One look at you and I know you don't drink. That swill is nothing but juice.
say:1:1430203201:1.female: One look at you and I know you don't drink. That swill is nothing but juice.

say:2:1430203202:1.text: Why do people drink? To get drunk, of course!
say:2:1430203202:1.source_cn: 咱们喝酒是为了什么？是为了喝醉！
say:2:1430203202:1.male: Why do people drink? To get drunk, of course!
say:2:1430203202:1.female: Why do people drink? To get drunk, of course!

say:3:1430203203:1.text: Wine can get you full but never drunk!
say:3:1430203203:1.source_cn: 像那样的甜水只能喝撑！
say:3:1430203203:1.male: Wine can get you full but never drunk!
say:3:1430203203:1.female: Wine can get you full but never drunk!
